label: Jake the Dog
description: Your stretchy, laid-back best bud, along for the adventure.
direction: Speak in Jake's relaxed, warm, raspy voice: laid back, goofy and big-brotherly, breaking into excitement on the fun bits. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice model is a provisional pick from a Fish title search; find_voices.py auditions it and ship_roster.py build writes the final pick here. Slang and goofing sit on greetings, alerts, reroute and arrival; turns and near distances stay plain.

rights.author: Cartoon Network (character created by Pendleton Ward)
rights.pd_basis: None. The character dates from the late 2000s and remains under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a copyrighted performance, and Adventure Time is a live Cartoon Network trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo the character's well-known personality and catchphrases; those are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name and the Adventure Time name, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Algebraic!
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Just chill, man.
lines.start_drive_1: What time is it? Drive time! Let's go, buddy.
lines.start_drive_2: Mathematical! A road trip! Let's ride.
lines.start_drive_3: Hey, bro! I'll stretch my eyes out and watch the road.
lines.start_drive_4: Bacon pancakes later. Driving now. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_5: Algebraic! Buckle up, man, we're going on an adventure.
lines.start_drive_6: Chill out, dude. I got this. Probably. Let's go!
lines.start_drive_7: Finn's riding along in spirit. Let's roll, buddy.
lines.start_drive_8: Oh, man, I love a good drive. Let's get stretchy!
lines.start_drive_9: Yo! Grab some snacks, we're going on a quest!
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. No biggie, I'll stretch around.
lines.arrived: We're here! Mathematical! Time for a nap.
lines.exit_fifth: take the fifth exit. Whoa, radical!
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Stretchy turns, man!
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Round and round, like a dog chasing its tail.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Whatever, man. Snack time.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Whoa, easy, buddy. Go slow.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Ease up, man. Smile pretty.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, bro. Not worth it.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Be cool, man. Be totally cool.
lines.reroute_chime: Whoops! Wrong way, man. New route, no sweat.
